name: Alex Rhondhurd
original_name: アレックス・ロンドハード
source:
The young leader, and the best knight in Aquria. Never slacking off, he's strict on himself. Beneath that cold exterior is a kind heart. He never wants to lose anyone important again...

[From in-app]
